E0918

`#Inline(Always) fn` had its address taken instead of being called directly (D-METHODMACRO1)

What

`#Inline(Always) fn` had its address taken instead of being called directly (D-METHODMACRO1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0918

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0918: tests/ui/inline_always_address_taken.stderr.

Error [E0112]: `apply` wants fn(Int) Int for argument 1, but this is fn(x: Int) Int
  --> tests/ui/inline_always_address_taken.jet:8:24
    |
  8 | fn run() { print(apply(triple, 5)) }
    |                        ^^^^^^
 Why: every argument must match its parameter's type
 Fix: use fn(Int) Int here
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0112

Error [E0112]: `apply` wants fn(Int) Int for argument 1, but this is fn(x: Int) Int
  --> tests/ui/inline_always_address_taken.jet:8:24
    |
  8 | fn run() { print(apply(triple, 5)) }
    |                        ^^^^^^
 Why: every argument must match its parameter's type
 Fix: use fn(Int) Int here
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0112

Error [E0918]: `triple` cannot be inlined: its address is taken
  --> tests/ui/inline_always_address_taken.jet:4:1
    |
  4 | #Inline(Always) fn triple(x: Int) Int -> { return x * 3 }
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `#Inline(Always)` promises every call to `triple` expands in place — but `triple` is also used as a plain value somewhere (stored, returned, or passed as a callback), and a value needs a real function to point at.
 Fix: drop `#Inline(Always)`, or call `triple` directly instead of through a value.
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0918
